claims.value: All customer responses require Jai's approval; he is the sole approver
claims.quote: Jai approves every response before it is sent to a customer. He is the only approver today.
claims.speaker: Jai

claims.value: Jai checks answers with the team that owns them
claims.quote: To check an answer is correct, Jai asks the team that owns it
claims.speaker: Jai

claims.value: Customers are informed promptly when a prior answer changes
claims.quote: Answers change during a deal. If we told a customer an audit was in progress and it becomes final, we tell them straight away.
claims.speaker: Jai
claims.note: The audit example is hypothetical, not a claim about an actual audit.

claims.value: Vanta answers are trusted more than other sources
claims.quote: Answers that come from the compliance platform (Vanta) are trusted more than other sources.
claims.speaker: Jai

claims.value: No central record of responses sent to each customer
claims.quote: There is no central record of what has been sent to each customer.
claims.speaker: Jai

asks.text: Provide a recent red-team or penetration-test report; evidence older than about six months may not work for a new customer.
asks.quote: evidence like a red-team or penetration-test report older than about 6 months will not work for a new customer.
